explanation:
Baseline feedback reported "object_type" invalid_output at first_invalid_action=0 on 8 of 10 problems, plus two resource_limit outcomes. Observations (scoped to these tasks only): (a) the previous artifact returned a list of strings, which matches the stated interface, so the object_type report cannot be fully explained from the recorded evidence; a plausible untested hypothesis is that the harness passes objects/init/goal as lists of lists (as in the JSON examples) and the old type-parsing tolerated that but its output/format handling or plan validation may have been at fault. To reduce dependence on that unknown, this revision normalises every predicate with a strict _norm conversion and handles both (name, type) and reversed/str forms defensively. (b) The old exhaustive breadth-first search over raw state sets is the most plausible cause of the two resource_limit reports; its branching over all men/spanners/nuts explodes and the greedy fallback can also loop, so it is removed entirely. (c) The old goal check `goal_set & nxt) - goal_set` in the greedy scorer was mathematically always empty, i.e. dead logic; that path is deleted.

The replacement is a direct constructive solver for this specific domain: repeatedly route the man along directed links to each still-loose goal nut, fetch a usable spanner (reusing one already carried or already co-located when possible), and tighten. Each step emits parenthesised strings with the exact domain argument order, all inputs are copied into new sets/lists so nothing is mutated, and every loop is over sorted collections so set iteration order is never relied upon. Emission is deterministic. No claim is made about optimality, about other tasks, or about why the object_type error arose; the change is justified as a bounded reduction of untested complexity under the same contract.
scope: Unverified model explanation, archived only; never actor context or measured benefit.
